purpose: Contract for guest-produced portable VM inventory input before classification into a VM Portability Plan.
rules: The collector emits observed guest state only; it does not decide public claims.
Every discovered inventory item must include id, observedState, and attributes.
Unknown process, device, database, network, or kernel state must remain present and classify to a stable portable-vm-* refusal code.
The classifier must produce one plan row for every inventory item.
The plan must keep publicClaimAllowed=false and arbitraryVmRestoreClaimed=false.

sections.filesystems: Guest file trees, mount points, frozen state, and content-addressing facts.
sections.services: Selected service manager metadata and target-native reconstruction requirements.
sections.processes: Process argv/env/cwd metadata plus unknown live process state that must be refused.
sections.network: TCP listeners that can be reconstructed and active streams that must be refused.
sections.databases: Clean quiesced databases that can use product tooling plus dirty/active state that must be refused.
sections.devices: Reconstructable virtual device configuration and opaque passthrough/device state refusals.
sections.kernelState: Declared mount/kernel metadata and active in-kernel continuations that must be refused.
